question: When was 'Nai Chetna-Pahal Badlav Ki' campaign launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tue Nov 01 2022 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Nai Chetna-Pahal Badlav Ki' campaign was launched on **November 1, 2022**.
 
• This campaign is part of a larger initiative aimed at empowering women and promoting gender equality.
 
• The campaign focuses on creating awareness about women's rights and issues related to gender-based violence.
 
• It involves various activities and programs to educate and sensitize communities, especially in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gender Equality:**

 
 
• Gender equality refers to the equal rights, responsibilities, and opportunities of women and men.
 
• It implies that the interests, needs, and priorities of both women and men are taken into consideration.
 
 
 
• **Women's Empowerment:**
 
 
• Empowerment of women involves providing them with the means to gain control over their own lives and make decisions.
 
• This includes access to education, healthcare, economic opportunities, and participation in political and social processes.
 
 
 
• **Gender-Based Violence (GBV):**
 
 
• GBV is violence directed against a person because of their gender.
 
• It includes acts that inflict physical, mental, or sexual harm or suffering, threats of such acts, coercion, and other deprivations of liberty.
 
 
 
• **Community Sensitization:**
 
 
• This involves educating and raising awareness among community members about social issues such as gender equality and GBV.
 
• The goal is to change attitudes and behaviors that perpetuate discrimination and violence against women.
